hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the way back is south

wards.name: the inner grate
wards.denied: An iron grate, dropped and seized in its runners. Somebody strong enough to break it, or the warden's key, and not otherwise.
wards.opened: The grate goes over with a noise the whole gate hears.

spots.line: The arch. Nothing beyond it agrees to be looked at directly.
Past the grate the stair goes down, and keeps going.
Shields stacked against the rock, all of them somebody else's.
Scorching up the stone, from the inside out.
A line scratched across the ground. Somebody decided this was far enough.

chests.line: A pack nobody came back for. It has been here a while.
Coin scattered where somebody dropped it running.
Past the grate, and nobody has been past the grate in a long time.

people.name: Hask the Gatewatch
chatter: Nobody stops you going in. Stopping people coming out is the job.
Count yourselves on the way through. Count again on the way back.
I have been here eleven years. It has never once been quiet.
That line on the ground is not superstition. Stand behind it.

people.name: Orin who came back
chatter: I went in. I am not going to describe it.
There were four of us. Do the sum yourself.
They give you water and they do not ask questions. That is decent of them.
